description: MUST-FAIL: escape-equivalent duplicate key. "key" and "key" resolve to the same Unicode string after JSON escape processing. Duplicate detection MUST happen after escape processing (post-parse), not on raw bytes.
spec_note: An implementation that compares raw bytes before escape processing would see "key" != "key" and miss the duplicate. The reference harness catches this via Python json.loads object_pairs_hook, which delivers post-escape keys.
